_note: ONE table of the signing tools and actions, read by bin/chain-sign-wiring-test.sh (who signs provenance: REQ-CHAIN-001-AC1) and bin/chain-records-test.sh (every produced record type has a row: REQ-CHAIN-003-AC3), so the two judges cannot disagree about what a signer is. `regex` finds the call in comment-stripped text (a shell comment or YAML comment exempts nothing: it is removed first). `prov` says whether the call signs SLSA provenance: always | never | if:<regex tested on the same logical command line, backslash continuations joined>. `pseudo` is the record type the records judge requires a row for when it has no finer resolver. Unknown signers fail closed: add the tool here, with a reason, before a workflow may use it. Modelled on: in-toto-witness docs/commands.md and options/run.go:64 (the attestations flag is -a/--attestations, a string slice, so -a slsa, -a=slsa, -a product,slsa and --attestations slsa are all the same request) and docs/attestors/slsa.md.
